definitions: A male given name from Spanish.
A district of Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines.

blocks.text: Paco is a Spanish nickname for Francisco. According to folk etymology, the nickname has its origins in Saint Francis of Assisi, who was the father of the Franciscan order; his name was written in Latin by the order as pater communitatis ; hence "Paco" was supposedly obtained by taking the first syllable of each word.
